description: Persist a durable user preference across sessions (dietary rule, allergy, budget habit, tip default). Save when the user states one ('no mushrooms ever', 'I usually tip 20%'). Keep each note short and self-contained.

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.

note.description: The preference, e.g. 'Avoid mushrooms in all dishes'

name: save_preference
